game_concept: A survival strategy set in Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall, a hall of dripping stalactites: the lantern keeper must handle slime blobs while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Stalactite Hall: a hall of dripping stalactites
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 7: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Characteristics and limits.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against slime blobs in Stalactite Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while count > 0.
source_player_objective: Protect the cave gate from slime blobs in Stalactite Hall: keep the count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
